changesApplied.changeMade: Added input validation to prevent SQL injection: vessel_name must be alphanumeric+hyphen+underscore, pod_ip must be valid IP format, acp_port must be 1-65535
changesApplied.reason: SQL injection vulnerability could allow attackers to delete entire vessel registry or manipulate vessel metadata. Input validation ensures all user-provided values are sanitized before query construction.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero breaking changes - validation only rejects invalid inputs that would cause errors anyway. Protects vessel registry integrity.
changesApplied.gapClosed: CRITICAL: SQL injection vulnerability, no input validation

changesApplied.changeMade: Added retry helper with exponential backoff (3 attempts, 1s initial delay) and wrapped docker exec spawn call in retry logic
changesApplied.reason: Transient container failures (restart, network issues) cause permanent delegation failure. Retry logic handles these gracefully and only fails after multiple attempts, improving reliability for distributed coordination.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - adds delay only on failure. Typical case unchanged. Max additional latency: 7s (1s + 2s + 4s) if all retries fail.
changesApplied.enforcementConstraint: Reliability: Retry logic for docker exec (3 attempts)

changesApplied.changeMade: Added protocol version check after handshake (expected: 1) and warning log for OpenCode version mismatch between host and remote
changesApplied.reason: Incompatible protocol versions cause silent failures or undefined behavior. Version check ensures compatibility and fails fast with clear error message if versions don't match.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero breaking changes for compatible versions. Fails fast for incompatible versions (better than silent corruption).
changesApplied.enforcementConstraint: Security: Version compatibility check in handshake

changesApplied.changeMade: Wrapped requestPermission call in Promise.race with 30s timeout. Auto-rejects permission on timeout.
changesApplied.reason: Without timeout, remote agent hangs indefinitely if host crashes or becomes unresponsive during permission request. 30s timeout prevents resource leaks and allows graceful degradation.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - 30s is generous for permission approval. Edge case: slow networks may hit timeout, but this is preferable to infinite hang.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added eventSubscriptions Map to track subscriptions, isActive flag to stop event loop, cleanupSession() method to unsubscribe
changesApplied.reason: Event subscriptions without cleanup cause memory leaks in long-running processes. Tracking and cleanup mechanism allows proper resource release when sessions close.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero breaking changes - cleanup is opt-in via cleanupSession(). Enables proper resource management for callers.
changesApplied.gapClosed: Missing: cleanup handlers, memory leak prevention, event buffering
changesApplied.enforcementConstraint: Reliability: Event subscription cleanup on session close

gapsNotAddressed.gap: Missing: caching layer, circuit breaker pattern
gapsNotAddressed.reason: Caching and circuit breaker are optimizations, not critical for correctness. Deferred to future work.

gapsNotAddressed.gap: Missing: transaction support, WAL for durability
gapsNotAddressed.reason: Atomic transactions and WAL are complex infrastructure changes. File system already provides reasonable durability. Deferred to storage refactor.
